data.name: Island God Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Take Control of Your Island, Lead Your Civilization!

Step into the shoes of a god in this sandbox survival simulator. Everything depends on you.
Your islanders won’t act on their own, resources won’t gather themselves, and your civilization won’t grow without your guidance.

Command your islanders to gather wood, build structures, assign tasks, and develop technology to keep your civilization thriving.
But beware — enemies will constantly attack, threatening your island and your people. You must plan wisely and protect your civilization from destruction.

Every decision matters:

  • Send islanders to gather resources, or focus on upgrading equipment?

  • Concentrate on advancing technology, or spread your efforts across the island?

  • Fortify your defenses first, or expand your territory?

Your choices will decide who survives… and who doesn’t.

Lead your islanders to survive, help your civilization flourish under your control, or watch it crumble if your plans fail.
A world full of strategy, tension, and freedom — every action you take shapes the fate of your island.
